    Selected Mantras

    “The sacred sound that transforms the space and awakens the soul.”

    There are melodies you hear, and sounds you experience in the deepest part of your being. This album gathers an exquisite selection of some of the most revered mantras of the Vedic tradition, designed to wrap your space in an atmosphere of serenity and connect you directly with the mystical essence of India.

    A musical offering conceived for meditation, yoga practice, or simply to create a refuge of peace in your daily life. Let the ancient vibrations flow and watch as the mind calms, the space fills with light, and awareness sinks into a state of unique introspection.
